messages:
sam: Heads up — noticed a regression hitting /v1/embeddings-rerank this morning, p95 token latency up ~2.2x and QPS dropped ~30% on a dedicated pool. Spotted around 07:12 UTC.

maria: Oof. Any obvious recent deploys or config flips?

sam: No deploys to runtime in last 24h, but infra pushed a kernel package update at 05:40. Kernel selection logs show fallbacks to generic_cuda_kernel on ~12% of requests for that model id.

alexa: Can you paste an example of the kernel log line?

sam: Sure — from the runtime logs: `kernel_selector: model=rerank-v2 device=tesla-v100 selected_kernel=optimized_attn_v2 warnings=[fallback_to_generic] reason=missing_optimized_config`

ryan: Interesting — fallback path does extra memcpy and slower matmul path. That would explain token-level latency increase. Do we have KV hit-rate tracers for those requests?

sam: KV hit-rate dropped from 93% -> 68% on that route during the spike window. Also batch sizes shifted: median batch decreased from 16 -> 6, but tail bin (>=64) appeared occasionally causing resource contention.

maria: Sounds like two issues: (1) kernel selection fallback for that device/model combo, (2) batching heuristics got skewed (smaller median but occasional large batches). Both can raise p95.

alexa: Can we get token-level breakdowns? We currently have per-request latency, but not split into token-gen, kv-lookup, kernel-exec, and memcpy. Adding that to the dashboard would help.

sam: I ran a quick flamegraph via pprof on a sample worker; top stacks were `memcpy_async` and `generic_cuda_matmul` during the regression window.

perf-bot: perf-diff: p95 increased 2.14x, CPU sys% +6, GPU memcpy throughput +28%.

ryan: For dashboards: propose adding three panels — token-latency-breakdown (stacked), per-route KV hit rate, and batch-size distribution heatmap (log bins). Also an alert when median batch < 8 and p95 > target.

maria: Agreed. For instrumentation: we should emit prometheus counters/gauges per-token-phase: token_serialize_ms, kv_lookup_ms, kernel_exec_ms, gpu_memcpy_ms. Labels: model_id, route, device_type, kernel_variant.

alexa: Example queries: `sum(rate(kernel_exec_ms_bucket[5m])) by (route, kernel_variant)` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))` — will help with SLOs.

sam: Also adding a kernel_selector dimension to the existing kernel_choice metric would let us correlate fallback events to latency.

ryan: Action items: 1) eng-runtime to add the per-token phase metrics + dashboard panels (alexa). 2) eng-ml to run kernel config audit for rerank-v2 and re-run kernel generation on V100 (maria). 3) infra to pin the runtime kernel package or roll back if audit finds mismatch (sam). 4) ops to add an alert for KV hit-rate drop below 80% for rerank route (ryan).

alexa: I can prototype the panels today and push a dashboard PR: queries + example gif for ops.

maria: I'll run a targeted kernel regen/pass on a staging V100 and share results — if optimized kernel reappears we can schedule a canary.

sam: Meanwhile I added a temporary traffic-shaping rule to smooth batch formation (max_batch_wait_ms=18 -> 12) to avoid huge tail batches. Monitoring now.

perf-bot: deploy-notify: dashboard-pr #492 created by alexa.

ryan: Great. Once we have per-token metrics we can attribute cost impact too. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
